name: Find Middle Node
description: Finds the middle node of a linked list using fast and slow pointer technique in a single pass.
aim: Find the middle element without knowing list length: slow pointer moves 1 step, fast pointer moves 2 steps — when fast reaches end, slow is at middle.
howItWorks: While fast and fast.next are not null:
When fast reaches end, slow points to middle

realWorld: Merge sort middle split on linked lists
alternatives: Two-pass: count length then traverse to n/2
